blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Police seized an estimated P2.24 million worth of suspected crystal meth, locally known as shabu, from a “high-value” suspect during an afternoon buy-bust operation in Barangay Indahag here on Wednesday. Joint operatives from the City Drug Enforcement Unit and the City Mobile Force Company arrested the 34-year-old suspect, identified by police only as alias “JR,” a resident of Barangay Canitoan. Authorities seized 11 sachets containing roughly 330 grams of the illicit drug stashed inside a cigarette box and a black pouch.
